# Two real samples, 5 s apart, from a Linux 6.x kernel with cgroup v2 (WSL 2, 4 vCPUs, 2026-10-29): /proc/stat, then the
# cgroup's cpu.stat. The gate test builds sampler lines from them the way run.sh does.

cpu0 0 0 34 483 0 0 3 0 0 0
